name: @pipeworx/mcp-facebook_ads

tools.name: fb_list_ad_accounts
tools.description: List all Facebook ad accounts you have access to. Returns account IDs, names, and status.

tools.name: fb_list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns in a Facebook ad account (e.g., account_id: '123456789'). Returns campaign names, IDs, status, and objectives.

act_account_id.description: Ad account ID with act_ prefix (e.g., "act_123456789")

tools.name: fb_get_campaign
tools.description: Get detailed campaign info: name, budget, status, schedule, and targeting. Requires account_id and campaign_id.

tools.name: fb_campaign_insights
tools.description: Get campaign performance metrics: impressions, clicks, spend, CTR, CPC, conversions, ROAS. Requires account_id and campaign_id.

time_range_since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (use instead of date_preset)

tools.name: fb_list_adsets
tools.description: List ad sets in a campaign (e.g., account_id: '123456789', campaign_id: '987654321'). Returns names, IDs, status, budgets, and targeting.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-facebook_ads forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the facebook_ads pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
